description: Unit test class for the ModifyFeatureDefinition component, testing its immutability, equality, exception handling, JSON serialization/deserialization, and object creation.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionTest
classes.description: Test class validating the behavior, immutability, and JSON serialization of ModifyFeatureDefinition.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ModifyFeatureDefinition instances are immutable and that FeatureDefinition and ThingId are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods work correctly for ModifyFeatureDefinition.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating a ModifyFeatureDefinition with null String ThingId throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating a ModifyFeatureDefinition with null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Tests that providing a null feature ID throws NullPointerException with proper message.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that providing a null feature definition throws NullPointerException with proper message.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that the JSON output of a ModifyFeatureDefinition instance matches the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Verifies that a ModifyFeatureDefinition can be created from valid JSON and that its fields match expected values.
